svg.title: The talk proposes removing a human from the defense loop
svg.desc: Draw a closed find/patch/deploy/rollback loop with the human at one segment and a separate removal proposal. Keep the proposal attributed; do not show it already implemented.

"reconstructed": true, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Location:** `composite-accountability-forum`

**Frame:** The third argument, and the one the forum was built to surface. A defensive loop is drawn as a closed circuit: find, patch, deploy, roll back. A small human figure stands inside one segment of it. An arrow labeled `REMOVE` points at the figure. The talk's stated reason is lettered beside it.

**Font:** `source-summary`

**Screen / system text — CITED, OPENAI AT BLACK HAT (PARAPHRASED):**
`PARTIAL AUTOMATION FAILS. AUTOMATING DISCOVERY WITHOUT AUTOMATING PATCHING ONLY DROWNS THE ENGINEERS.`

`THE LOOP NEEDS TO BE FULLY AUTOMATED IN ITS END STATE.`

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-BH` 33:17–33:52.

", "title": "The talk proposes removing a human from the defense loop" } }
